title: ConversationResponse
description: Represents an active agent conversation context (MS Teams channel or group chat).

conversationName.description: Human-readable name of the conversation channel or group chat.

contextRef.description: Caller-supplied reference key used to reuse an existing conversation.

agentId.description: Identifier of the agent that owns this conversation.

sessionId.description: LangGraph session (checkpointer) ID for agent continuity.

lastMessageAt.description: Timestamp of the last message activity in this conversation.
